list.name: exp
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT exp FROM metric_sampler.batches GROUP BY exp ORDER BY exp = (SELECT exp FROM metric_sampler.viewer_selection WHERE viewer = '${__user.login}' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, max(ingested_at) DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE exp = '${exp}' GROUP BY run ORDER BY run = (SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.viewer_selection WHERE viewer = '${__user.login}' AND exp = '${exp}' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, max(ingested_at) DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0

list.name: capture_interval
list.label: capture_interval
list.query: SELECT greatest(max(capture_interval), 1) FROM metric_sampler.node_manifests WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}'

list.name: remember
list.label: Remembered selection
list.query: SELECT '' AS remembered SETTINGS log_comment = 'ms-selection ${__user.login} ${exp} ${run}', use_query_cache = 0

targets.rawSql: SELECT exp, run, max_step, max_ingested_at, last_collected_at, health_max_step, health_refreshed_at, dateDiff('second', max_ingested_at, now64(3)) AS seconds_since_ingest FROM metric_sampler.pipeline_freshness ORDER BY max_ingested_at DESC SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Node windows: dropped, torn and late slots, identical violations

targets.rawSql: SELECT * EXCEPT raw FROM metric_sampler.node_manifests WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' ORDER BY node, first_step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Completeness: finalized nodes and contributors
panels.description: Complete snapshots of received raw observations, refreshed one 10-step window at a time after family ingestion. Earlier steps remain visible while new windows and backfills are processed. Pipeline freshness shows the latest summarized step. Missing values are not zeros; NULL gap markers separate missing steps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.* FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, nodes_present, nodes_expected, contributors_total / greatest(expected_contributors_total, 1) AS contributor_ratio, identical_violations FROM metric_sampler.health_serving_per_step WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, nodes_present, nodes_expected, contributor_ratio, identical_violations FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS nodes_present, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS nodes_expected, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS contributor_ratio, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS identical_violations FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Required raw observations missing — latest recorded step
panels.description: Counts expected capture slots that were not observed on each rank. Legacy runs without sampler/missing_slots are unknown, not zero. A healthy transport ratio alone does not establish that model hooks ran.

targets.rawSql: WITH observed AS (SELECT s.step AS step, s.node AS node, s.rank AS rank, s.values[1] AS missing_slots FROM metric_sampler.scalars AS s FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT exp, run, step, attempt FROM metric_sampler.latest_attempt_step WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') AS latest ON s.exp = latest.exp AND s.run = latest.run AND s.step = latest.step AND s.attempt = latest.attempt INNER JOIN metric_sampler.metric_names AS mn ON mn.exp = s.exp AND mn.run = s.run AND mn.attempt = s.attempt AND mn.metric_id = s.metric_id WHERE s.exp = '${exp}' AND s.run = '${run}' AND mn.name = 'sampler/missing_slots' AND s.metric_id IN (SELECT metric_id FROM metric_sampler.metrics WHERE name = 'sampler/missing_slots')), summary AS (SELECT max(step) AS latest_step, sum(missing_slots) AS missing_slots_total, max(missing_slots) AS missing_slots_max_rank, uniqExact(tuple(node, rank)) AS reporting_ranks FROM observed WHERE step = (SELECT max(step) FROM observed) HAVING count() > 0) SELECT summary.latest_step AS step, summary.missing_slots_total, summary.missing_slots_max_rank, summary.reporting_ranks, if(isNull(summary.latest_step), 'Unknown: capture coverage was not recorded', if(summary.missing_slots_total > 0, 'Missing required observations', 'All required observations reported on reporting ranks')) AS status FROM summary RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1
